# Q-050 E18: a transaction refused after one of its own positions resolved, and
# a fee below stating the position of its arrival.
#
# Transaction 0 brings 2,720.00 USD in and takes a 0.72 USD fee out stating no
# cost basis, and is refused for it (E10). Transaction 1 brings 100.00 USD in,
# its first fee stating its own arrival's position, which resolves, and its
# second stating transaction 0's arrival, which is refused: transaction 0 was
# not imported. Transaction 1 is destroyed with its splits, so transaction 2's
# fee, stating transaction 1's arrival, is refused the same way, saying
# transaction 1 was not imported. The book is left holding no cost basis.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_split_draws_on_a_cost_basis_by_its_position_in_the_file.py.
2026-08-13 * "Received money, less the transfer fee"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Wise USD 2720.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "380000/272000"
		value: "3800.00"
	Assets:Wise USD -0.72 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "101/72"
		value: "-1.01"
	Income:Sales -3800.00 CAD
	Expenses:Bank charges 1.01 CAD

2026-08-14 * "More money received, less two transfer fees"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"

		share_price: "7/5"
		value: "140.00"

		value: "-1.01"
		cost_basis_split_guid: $transactions_to_import[1].splits[0].guid$
